faq_heading: Port Moody and Anmore schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 12 schools with a Port Moody and Anmore street address: 12 public schools and 0 independent schools. In that list, 2 schools marked as offering French Immersion.
Public schools here are run by School District 43 (Coquitlam). Count by district: School District 43 (Coquitlam): 12.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.
By mailing community, the Port Moody and Anmore list splits as Port Moody (10) and Anmore (2).
Public secondary schools with a Port Moody and Anmore address: Heritage Woods Secondary and Port Moody Secondary.
The Ministry file marks these Port Moody and Anmore schools as offering French Immersion: École Glenayre Elementary and École Moody Middle.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
Port Moody and Anmore are separate municipalities that share a school district, so they share this list.

faq.q: How many schools are in Port Moody and Anmore, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 12 schools with a Port Moody and Anmore street address: 12 public schools and 0 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers Port Moody and Anmore?
faq.a: Public schools with a Port Moody and Anmore address are run by School District 43 (Coquitlam).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a Port Moody and Anmore address?
faq.a: Ask School District 43 (Coquitlam) to confirm it for the exact street address.
